column1: # Real SIGNED-return persistence at four horizons: the variance-ratio ladder `MarketSim.VarRatioBands`
# and the adjacent-rung slope bands `VarRatioSlopeBands` are derived from this file, and
# `PersistenceAnchorSuite` / `persistence_anchor_tests` re-derive them.  Editing a row moves the
# shipped bands.  Nothing else is fitted from this file; the loss row keeps its theory value of 1.00.
# vr(q) = Var(non-overlapping q-session sums) / (q * Var(daily)), sample variances (n-1), the
# series truncated to a whole number of blocks -- `uni.apps.MarketSim.varianceRatio` over
# `MarketSim.dailyReturns` (LOG returns of the price series) exactly; the same functions measure
# every model path.  1.0 is no serial dependence at that horizon; above 1 is trend, below is mean
# WHAT THIS FILE SETTLES.  Volatility clustering is measured on |r| and is blind to signed
# persistence, so nothing else in the target set stops the model from manufacturing a trend.
# Modern series mean-revert mildly at one to six months (vr60 0.55-1.15 across 18 instruments and
# two windows, vr120 0.43-1.30); the pre-war century trends mildly (1.17 at both short rungs).
# QQQ and SPY over their full histories are indistinguishable, which is why the bands are shared
# across anchor sets rather than carried per asset.  At 250 sessions the record itself spans
# 0.24-1.56, so that rung cannot discriminate; it is graded inside the profile row rather than
# dropped, so a world clears the ladder as a shape and never rung by rung.  The two short slopes
# vr60-vr20 (-0.24..+0.10) and vr120-vr60 (-0.26..+0.16) are the shape the boxes cannot see.
# Measured 2026-09-02, superseding persistence-2026-08-29.tsv (vr20/vr60 only).  The 36 fund rows
# reproduce that file's vr20/vr60 to the printed digit.  Its three CRSP rows do not (1.143 vs
# 1.175 at c1926 vr60), and it recorded no construction for them; the construction here is stated
#   wfull  each instrument's full history through 2026-08-03
#   w2001  2001-08-27.. -- the window the depth cross-section in yahoo-2026-08-24.tsv uses
#   c1926/c1954/c1990  CRSP value-weighted US market TOTAL return -- Ken French's
#          a price index, then log returns of it -- windows opening 1926-07-01, 1954-01-04 and
#   years  the calendar span of the window
# Fund series are daily Yahoo adjusted closes -- the same source and definition as the depth
# cross-section, from a local cache holding 18 of that file's 35 instruments.
